Watson & Hines LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 832-555-6543
Settlement Demand
11 Mar 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1490 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
We write to present a settlement demand on behalf of our client, Brandon Allen, arising from the motor vehicle
collision that occurred on 1 Apr 2023. Your insured's vehicle crossed into the opposing lane and struck our client's
vehicle head-on. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force transferred enough to cause our client
immediate and ongoing harm.
Following the collision, our client was evaluated and diagnosed with cervical and lumbar strain. Symptoms include
persistent neck stiffness, restricted range of motion, lower back pain, and headaches. Our client has attended a
course of physical therapy and has been advised to limit lifting and prolonged driving while recovery continues.
Treatment records and billing statements are enclosed for your review.
Liability in this matter is clear. The police report documents your insured's failrue to maintain control of the vehicle,
and no evidence suggests our client contributed to the collision in any way.
Accordingly, we demand payment of $210,000.00 to resolve all bodily injury cliams against your insured. This
demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within
that period, we will file suit without further notice to your office.
We look forward to your prompt reply.
Expert review: Christian Carter, pain management physician
Sincerely,
Jacob Holmes
Watson & Hines LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
